svg.title: The source has more than one kind of entry
svg.desc: A four-by-four stress-energy matrix colors energy density, mixed energy-momentum entries, and spatial stresses differently. S is energy flux, π is momentum density, and σ denotes the spatial stress entries using the momentum-flux convention. The tensor is symmetric in ordinary metric GR.

g.text: 17 / THE SOURCE HAS MORE THAN ONE KIND OF ENTRY
Energy and momentum, in one local inertial frame

svg.aria-label: Coordinates x⁰ = ct. Every entry has energy-density units.
ε: what the observer finds locally.
